rationale: Kaarel is a founding ML engineer shipping consumer AI products at a Forerunner-backed startup, while Ethan leads San Francisco General Intelligence Laboratory—both operating at the intersection of ML research and real-world application in SF. Kaarel's conviction that matching problems in consumer AI are solvable with modern ML and his track record moving fast across the ML stack could complement Ethan's ML research focus, particularly around potential research-to-product collaboration opportunities.
intro_message: Kaarel Kaarelson, meet Ethan Castiglione — you're both deeply embedded in SF's ML scene, with Kaarel shipping consumer AI at Known.com and Ethan directing SF General Intelligence Lab, and might find common ground on applied ML research.
